entries.239e2a891b2735ff: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥135 million, up 12.6% year on year. This derives from antibody research support and antibody and reagent sales, and the company has a single segment, the Pharmaceutical Business.
entries.2dee7dcce79c8e52: Using hybridoma, phage display and single B cell screening methods, it obtains highly functional antibodies and advances their research and development as antibody drug candidates. Its development candidates include PPMX-T002, a radioisotope-labeled antibody targeting cadherin-3; PPMX-T003, which targets transferrin receptor 1; and PPMX-T004, an antibody-drug conjugate targeting cadherin-3, and it aims to secure contract upfront payments and milestone revenue through licensing to pharmaceutical companies in Japan and overseas. Revenue is not separately disclosed.

entries.6bcb17ec3296b9e1: Its basic policy is to advance research and development of therapeutic antibody drugs for cancer and other diseases, leveraging protein expression technology developed at LSBM, antibody screening technology using phage antibody libraries, and seed discovery technology. Its key medium- to long-term issue is to continuously create new antibodies. It states that it will continue exploratory research to enrich its development pipeline, advance clinical development, and promote R&D while securing new partners, obtaining R&D grants, forming partnerships with partners in Japan and overseas as needed, and raising funds from capital markets.

entries.8c70661d01235f9c: This is the company’s single segment. Based on protein expression and antibody production technologies developed at the Laboratory of Systems Biomedicine (LSBM), Research Center for Advanced Science and Technology, The University of Tokyo, it conducts research and development of antibody drugs and related operations in three fields: drug discovery, antibody research support, and antibody and reagent sales. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥135 million.
entries.a04aa87a1369ec7e: Its strength is the ability to efficiently acquire high-affinity functional antibodies that reflect the three-dimensional structure of target proteins, by combining protein expression technology that enables immunization against target proteins that were previously difficult to produce with the proprietary ICOS screening technology applied to a diverse phage antibody library.
entries.b97d5c2668d5bd5d: Perseus Proteomics is headquartered in Chuo-ku, Tokyo, and does not prepare consolidated financial statements. As of March 31, 2026, the company had 35 employees and has a research base, the Nagoya Lab, in Nagoya City.
